## Architecture Guidance Metadata

```yaml
guidance_id: 'GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<TYPE>-RAD-3.D.NN'
guidance_name: '<Name>: Reference Architecture'
guidance_type: 'reference-architecture-document'
rad_type: '<composite / component>'
paired_abb: '<GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<TYPE>-2.D.NN>'       # Component ABB this RAD pairs with
parent_abb: '<GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-ABB-1.D.NN>'           # Composite ABB for this capability domain
parent_vision: '<GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-VISION-0.D.NN>'
adm_phase: 'Phase C-D'
category: '<application | business | infrastructure | information | technology | itsm-operations | governance>'
version: '0.1.0'
status: 'draft'
applicability: '<enterprise | domain | project | component>'
tags: ['<domain>', '<capability-tag>', 'reference-architecture', 'phase-c', 'phase-d']
author: '<Author Name>'
```

> **Before authoring this RAD**: verify the paired Component ABB (`GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<TYPE>-2.D.NN`) exists at `draft` status or higher. RADs must not be authored before their parent ABB. See `togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md` §2.0 in the same artifacts template directory — update this path when copying this template to its production location.

---

> **Informative Content Notice**: Technology choices, tooling names, and vendor references in this document are **illustrative only** — they represent one class of solution, not a mandated selection. Organizations SHOULD evaluate tooling based on integration fit, licensing, and operational context.
>
> **The architectural patterns in this document support realization of the normative requirements defined in the paired ABB** ([`<GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<TYPE>-2.D.NN>`](<relative-path-to-abb>.md)) and represent expected design outcomes. Implementation teams SHALL deliver the described capability outcomes; the specific tooling used to realize them is a local implementation decision. For testable behavioral expectations, see the paired BDD Specification.

---

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/abb-rad-template.md#normative-language-inheritance]

### Normative Language Inheritance

Per the parent ABB: **SHALL** = mandatory; **SHOULD** = strongly recommended; **MAY** = optional. This RAD is **informative** — it does not add new normative requirements. All normative requirements are inherited from the parent ABB.
